standard_prerequisites.use: Normalization of a locally Noetherian scheme, integral closure, and the description of henselization and strict henselization as filtered colimits of etale algebras; the reductions are retained.

core_obligations: Identify the base change of the normalization to the local ring at the point with the spectrum of the integral closure in the product of residue fields of the generic points through the point.
Solve the resulting algebra problem by expressing henselization and strict henselization as filtered colimits of etale algebras, over which integral closure commutes.

proof_roadmap.step: Identify the base change of the normalization with an integral closure in a product of residue fields.
Reduce to the corresponding algebra problem for the local ring.
Use the colimit description of henselization and strict henselization to conclude.

difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that base changing the normalization morphism along the henselization or strict henselization of the local ring at a point yields the normalization of that henselian local scheme. The proof first identifies the base change of the normalization to the local ring with the spectrum of the integral closure in the product of the residue fields of the generic points through the point, and then solves the resulting algebra problem by writing the henselization and strict henselization as filtered colimits of etale algebras, over which integral closure commutes. The reduction to a colimit statement about integral closure is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 5452-5496.
